For a suspected security or privacy defect, follow SECURITY.md; do not disclose it in a public issue.

## What happened?

Describe expected and observed behavior.

## Environment

- App version or source revision:
- OS and architecture:
- Receiver model and driver/library versions (no serial identifiers):
- Survey span, input rate and relevant settings (no keys or location):

## Reproduction

Prefer synthetic input. State whether the issue occurs with GPS/discovery enabled and whether there are acquisition or discovery gaps. Do not perform additional live collection solely for this report without permission.

## Sanitized evidence

Include only the minimum relevant counters/error text. Review screenshots manually. Do not attach whole session databases, raw IQ, packet dumps, private messages, keys, GPS routes, device IDs, personal paths or unsanitized logs.

- [ ] I reviewed this report and attachments for credentials, location and other private information.
